parameters.query:
select
  (select count(*) from cita where estado = 'confirmada') as citas_confirmadas,
  (select count(*) from cita where estado = 'atendida')   as citas_atendidas,
  (select count(*) from cita where estado = 'cancelada')  as citas_canceladas,
  (select count(*) from cita where estado = 'ausente')    as citas_ausentes,
  (select count(*) from solicitud_cita where estado = 'pendiente') as sol_pendientes,
  (select count(*) from solicitud_cita where estado = 'asignada')  as sol_asignadas,
  (select count(*) from solicitud_cita where estado = 'en_espera') as sol_en_espera,
  (select count(*) from solicitud_cita where estado = 'rechazada') as sol_rechazadas,
  (select count(*) from lista_espera where atendida = false) as espera_pendientes,
  (select count(*) from lista_espera where atendida = true)  as espera_atendidas,
  (select count(*) from paciente where activo = true) as pacientes_activos,
  (select count(*) from solicitud_cita
    where creado_en >= now() - interval '7 days') as sol_semana,
  (select count(*) from cita
    where creado_en >= now() - interval '7 days') as citas_semana,
  (select count(*) from log_errores
    where severidad = 'alta' and creado_en >= now() - interval '7 days') as errores_alta,
  (select count(*) from log_errores
    where severidad = 'media' and creado_en >= now() - interval '7 days') as errores_media,
  (select count(*) from log_errores
    where severidad = 'baja' and creado_en >= now() - interval '7 days') as errores_baja;

select m.nombre, m.especialidad,
       count(c.id) filter (where c.estado = 'atendida')   as atendidas,
       count(c.id) filter (where c.estado = 'confirmada') as confirmadas,
       count(c.id) filter (where c.estado = 'ausente')    as ausentes
from medico m
left join cita c on c.id_medico = m.id
where m.activo = true
group by m.id, m.nombre, m.especialidad
order by m.nombre;
